designationHistory.indexText: Trinity River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1994 to protect what was once a much larger, frequently flooded, bottomland hardwood forest ecosystem along the Trinity River.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
